# Camp Resource: Fish Trap

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Apr 11, 2025
- 2 min read

Updated: May 24, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ac5b8ea25ef34d12b6dd50925c81b832~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Why stand around when you can let the fish come to you with the Fish Trap.

Generates Fish.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Fish Trap__

Must be placed in water.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_55866f8265a443d5a2dbf1a23bbcd14d~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d00d671b685f4a808d1c1fe61c7cafdc~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Small Fish - 33% chance for one of:

- Brook Silverside
- Redbelly
- Sunscream

Medium Fish - 67% chance for one of:

- Chain Pickeral
- Ridge Trout
- Smoky Salmon
- Walleye
- Yellow Bullhead

*If there is a Daily or Weekly Score Challenge to **COLLECT** (not catch) a Fish, Small or Medium Fish, then grabbing a fish from this trap should count, similar to how the Games Cupboard works now.

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Materials required to craft resource**

3x Steel

2x Wood

**Holds**

10 Pounds

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - X - X Atoms

Atom Shop - X Bundle - X Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
